Package ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.gazelle

Class GazelleValidationWs

java.lang.Object
ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.gazelle.GazelleValidationWs
@RestController @RequestMapping(path="/gazelle") public class GazelleValidationWs extends Object
The WebService for validation with the Gazelle Validation Service API.

Both versions of the API are served: v2 under /validation/v2/, v1 under /validation/. The models follow v2; GazelleApiV1Mapper reads and writes the v1 JSON.

Author:
Quentin Ligier
